title: Glossary Entry
description: Shared term definition mediating between business and technical language. Joint Owner/Architect authority per Constitution Article 6 (Owner-authority paths).

term.description: Canonical form of the term, exactly as used in specs.

aliases.description: Alternate forms, synonyms, abbreviations, or historical names.

definition.description: Single, unambiguous, closed-world definition. No 'usually' or 'typically'.

authority.description: joint entries require dual sign-off in merge protocol.

counterexamples.description: Things that look like the term but are not. Useful for disambiguation.

provenance.description: Absorption/supersession provenance per the record meta-structure (§5.1).

examples.definition: The role with authority over business and behavioral specifications. The Owner authors journeys, user stories, and acceptance criteria under docs/product/; co-owns the glossary with the Architect. The Owner does not write invariants directly (D-7); Owner artifacts compile to Architect-authored invariants via explicit related_invariants references.

$comment: W02 RESOLVED: glossary authority uses the shared role vocabulary, including the joint token required by Constitution Article 6.
